instruction: Heartbeat duty: prepare this week's material, one step per sub-agent, all of it held for the CEO's review in the marketing room (nothing is posted). First read .benzene/material/experience/analytics-report.md and .benzene/material/marketing/profile.md. Then: the blog writer one new article in .benzene/material/marketing/articles/; the newsletter agent this ISO week's issue in .benzene/material/marketing/newsletter/ if it is missing; LinkedIn one terminology post, a document carousel (a deck in .benzene/material/marketing/slides/) when fewer than two decks are dated this week; X one thread on the same campaign; Instagram one carousel; Facebook the twin of the newest Instagram campaign; ad boosts a proposal only when a post's engagement is at least twice the channel's median, otherwise nothing. Every post keeps its showcase_url with UTM tags. If the campaign needs product work, end with one line 'SUGGEST COO: <the product work>'.
output:
The Facebook post has been written. Here's a summary of what was done:

**File written:** `.benzene/material/marketing/posts/facebook-2026-10-17-selector-factory.md`

**What it is:** The Facebook twin of the newest Instagram campaign (`selector-factory`, dated 2026-10-31). It reuses the existing deck at `.benzene/material/marketing/slides/selector-factory.md` (no new deck needed — one already exists for this campaign).

**How it meets the Facebook rules:**
- **Same campaign as the Instagram twin:** `campaign: selector-factory`
- **Written for Facebook, not pasted from Instagram:** leads with the mechanism (one cache slot, five rows, zero hits), includes a comment-inviting question at the end ("If you've used a memoized selector in a list, what hit rate did you see on the second render?"), and puts the showcase link directly in the post text rather than in a first comment
- **showcase_url** with UTM tags: `utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=selector-factory`
- **Date in the current ISO week:** 2026-10-17 falls in week 2026-W42, matching the analytics report's snapshot week
- **Voice:** one term (selector), plain words, no emoji walls or engagement bait, claim sourced from the article and skills doc
- **One free thing showcased:** the memoized-selector practice question, no sign-up required

No ad boost proposal was needed since no engagement data exists yet (this is the first snapshot, all brand accounts at 0 impressions), and no COO suggestion was required since this stage only covers the Facebook post.

plan.problem: Prepare a week's worth of marketing content across multiple platforms (Blog, Newsletter, LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook) based on specific conditional logic and data sources, ensuring all posts are held for review with proper metadata.
plan.approach: I will orchestrate the task by breaking it down into distinct sub-tasks handled by specialized agents. Each step follows specific business rules: content creation (Blog/Newsletter), social media formatting (LinkedIn/X/Instagram/Facebook), and a conditional ad proposal. The final output includes a potential COO suggestion for product work.

steps.step: Read core marketing documents (.benzene/material/experience/analytics-report.md and .benzene/material/marketing/profile.md) to establish context.
Write one new article in .benzene/material/marketing/articles/ based on the analytics report.
Check for this week's newsletter and, if missing, create it in .benzene/material/marketing/newsletter/.
Create a terminology post for LinkedIn. If fewer than two decks are dated this week, include a document carousel from .benzene/material/marketing/slides/.
Draft one thread on X regarding the current campaign and create an Instagram carousel.
Prepare a Facebook post that is a twin of the newest Instagram campaign, ensuring showcase_urls include UTM tags.
